```{python}
#| label: fig-scr
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "The silicon-controlled rectifier (SCR) in CMOS: (a) the PNPN structure formed by the $p^+$ anode diffusion, the n-well, the $p$-substrate, and the $n^+$ cathode diffusion; (b) equivalent circuit of the two cross-coupled parasitic bipolar transistors—if their loop gain exceeds unity, the structure latches into a low-ohmic state."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, FancyArrowPatch

fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8, 3.6),
                        gridspec_kw={'width_ratios': [1.4, 1]})

C = dict(sub='#f5e9d0', nwell='#aacdea', nplus='#4a7fb5', pplus='#d1862c')

# (a) cross section
ax = axs[0]
SURF = 3.0
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0), 12, SURF, fc=C['sub'], ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(2.6, 0.5, 'p-substrate', fontsize=8)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((5.6, 1.1), 6.0, SURF - 1.1, fc=C['nwell'],
                       ec='k', lw=0.8))
ax.text(9.8, 1.4, 'n-well', fontsize=8)


def diff(x0, w, typ, lbl):
    fc = C['nplus'] if typ == 'n' else C['pplus']
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((x0, SURF - 0.5), w, 0.5, fc=fc, ec='k',
                           lw=0.6))
    ax.text(x0 + w / 2, SURF - 0.25, lbl, ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=7, color='white')


diff(1.2, 1.4, 'n', '$n^+$')   # cathode
diff(3.4, 1.4, 'p', '$p^+$')   # substrate tie
diff(6.4, 1.4, 'p', '$p^+$')   # anode
diff(9.0, 1.4, 'n', '$n^+$')   # well tie

for x, t in [(1.9, 'cathode\n($V_\\mathrm{SS}$)'),
             (4.1, 'sub. tie\n($V_\\mathrm{SS}$)'),
             (7.1, 'anode\n($V_\\mathrm{DD}$)'),
             (9.7, 'well tie\n($V_\\mathrm{DD}$)')]:
    ax.annotate(t, xy=(x, SURF), xytext=(x, SURF + 1.0), fontsize=7,
                ha='center', arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', lw=0.7))

ax.text(6.1, 0.55, 'PNPN path', fontsize=8, color='#b02020')
ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((7.1, 2.3), (1.9, 2.2), arrowstyle='->',
                             mutation_scale=10, lw=1.2, color='#b02020',
                             connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.25'))
ax.set_xlim(-0.2, 12.2)
ax.set_ylim(-0.3, 5.2)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('(a)', fontsize=10)

# (b) equivalent circuit (drawn schematically with matplotlib)
ax = axs[1]
ax.axis('off')
ax.set_xlim(0, 6)
ax.set_ylim(0, 7)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.set_title('(b)', fontsize=10)

# classic thyristor equivalent: PNP (top) and NPN (bottom) cross-coupled
# PNP: emitter to VDD, base = NPN collector; NPN: emitter to VSS,
# base = PNP collector

# supply rails
ax.plot([2.0, 4.0], [6.3, 6.3], 'k-', lw=1.2)
ax.text(3.0, 6.55, '$V_\\mathrm{DD}$ (anode)', ha='center', fontsize=9)
ax.plot([2.0, 4.0], [1.3, 1.3], 'k-', lw=1.2)
ax.text(3.0, 0.85, '$V_\\mathrm{SS}$ (cathode)', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# PNP symbol (circle, base on the right)
ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((2.3, 5.0), 0.6, fc='none', ec='k', lw=1.2))
ax.plot([2.4, 2.4], [4.65, 5.35], 'k-', lw=2.0)          # base bar
ax.plot([2.4, 2.9], [5.0, 5.0], 'k-', lw=1.0)            # base lead
ax.annotate('', xy=(2.4, 5.22), xytext=(2.0, 5.45),      # emitter (arrow
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', lw=1.0,    # into base: PNP)
                            color='k', shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))
ax.plot([2.0, 2.0], [5.45, 6.3], 'k-', lw=1.0)           # emitter to VDD
ax.plot([2.4, 2.0], [4.8, 4.55], 'k-', lw=1.0)           # collector
ax.text(1.55, 5.35, 'PNP', ha='right', va='center', fontsize=8)

# NPN symbol (circle, base on the left)
ax.add_patch(plt.Circle((3.7, 2.6), 0.6, fc='none', ec='k', lw=1.2))
ax.plot([3.6, 3.6], [2.25, 2.95], 'k-', lw=2.0)          # base bar
ax.plot([3.1, 3.6], [2.6, 2.6], 'k-', lw=1.0)            # base lead
ax.plot([3.6, 4.0], [2.8, 3.05], 'k-', lw=1.0)           # collector
ax.annotate('', xy=(4.0, 2.17), xytext=(3.6, 2.4),       # emitter (arrow
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-|>', lw=1.0,    # away: NPN)
                            color='k', shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))
ax.plot([4.0, 4.0], [2.17, 1.3], 'k-', lw=1.0)           # emitter to VSS
ax.text(4.45, 2.25, 'NPN', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8)

# node A: PNP base = NPN collector, tied to VDD via R_well
ax.plot([2.9, 4.0], [5.0, 5.0], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([4.0, 4.0], [3.05, 5.0], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([4.0], [5.0], 'ko', ms=3.5)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.85, 5.45), 0.3, 0.7, fc='white', ec='k', lw=1.0))
ax.plot([4.0, 4.0], [5.0, 5.45], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([4.0, 4.0], [6.15, 6.3], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.text(4.3, 5.8, '$R_\\mathrm{well}$', va='center', fontsize=8)

# node B: NPN base = PNP collector, tied to VSS via R_sub
ax.plot([2.0, 3.1], [2.6, 2.6], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([2.0, 2.0], [2.6, 4.55], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([2.0], [2.6], 'ko', ms=3.5)
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.85, 1.45), 0.3, 0.7, fc='white', ec='k', lw=1.0))
ax.plot([2.0, 2.0], [2.15, 2.6], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.plot([2.0, 2.0], [1.3, 1.45], 'k-', lw=1.0)
ax.text(1.7, 1.8, '$R_\\mathrm{sub}$', ha='right', va='center',
        fontsize=8)

ax.text(3.0, 0.2, '$\\beta_\\mathrm{NPN} \\cdot \\beta_\\mathrm{PNP} \\geq 1$'
        ' $\\Rightarrow$ latched', ha='center', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
